mapper.sql: select station_id, station_name, station_code, merchant_id, province, city, district, address, longitude, latitude, geo_hash, marker_icon_url, marker_size, total_piles, available_piles, occupying_piles, open_time, close_time, parking_fee, service_phone, facilities_info, images, is_internal, apply_status, audit_remark, audit_time, business_license, site_proof, station_status, create_time, update_time from stad_charging_station
mapper.select: where merchant_id = #{merchantId} order by create_time desc
mapper.insert:
insert into stad_charging_station
station_name, station_code, merchant_id, province, city, district, address, longitude, latitude, geo_hash, marker_icon_url, marker_size, total_piles, available_piles, occupying_piles, open_time, close_time, parking_fee, service_phone, facilities_info, images, is_internal, apply_status, station_status, business_license, site_proof, create_time,
#{stationName}, #{stationCode}, #{merchantId}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{address}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{geoHash}, #{markerIconUrl}, #{markerSize}, #{totalPiles}, #{availablePiles}, #{occupyingPiles}, #{openTime}, #{closeTime}, #{parkingFee}, #{servicePhone}, #{facilitiesInfo}, #{images}, #{isInternal}, #{applyStatus}, #{stationStatus}, #{businessLicense}, #{siteProof}, #{createTime},
mapper.select: SELECT s.station_id AS stationId, s.station_name AS stationName, s.station_status AS stationStatus, s.total_piles AS totalPiles, s.available_piles AS availablePiles, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS todayIncome, COUNT(o.order_id) AS todayOrders, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_energy), 0) AS todayEnergy FROM stad_charging_station s LEFT JOIN stad_charging_order o ON s.station_id = o.station_id AND o.create_time >= CURDATE() AND o.create_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY WHERE s.merchant_id = #{merchantId} GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name, s.station_status, s.total_piles, s.available_piles ORDER BY s.create_time DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS totalIncome, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_energy), 0) AS totalEnergy, COUNT(o.order_id) AS totalOrders FROM stad_charging_station s LEFT JOIN stad_charging_order o ON s.station_id = o.station_id AND o.create_time >= CURDATE() AND o.create_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY WHERE s.merchant_id = #{merchantId}

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.pile_code AS pileCode, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.start_time AS startTime, o.total_energy AS energy, o.total_amount AS amount FROM stad_charging_order o JOIN stad_charging_station s ON o.station_id = s.station_id WHERE s.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
